top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check (26 TAC §745.621(b)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Background check renewals are needed for three household members.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of  Caregivers -Treat Children with Courtesy, Respect, Acceptance, Patience (26 TAC §747.1501(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that a child in care was not treated with patience when the caregiver used a form of prohibited punishment after a child threw their food during lunch time.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was missing training for the previous training year in the following topics:  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome,  Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS),  Understanding early childhood brain development.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.
